mechanism.claim: An extreme realized-kurtosis completed UTC day during elevated realized variation identifies discontinuous, information-heavy price discovery rather than diffuse noise. Follow the completed BTC day direction for twenty-four elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of completed UTC-day BTC log return
mechanism.why_distinct: No repository alpha uses causal realized kurtosis or quarticity concentration as its primary economic object. Realized-skew reversal, bipower-jump reversal, dominant-bar, entropy, and range candidates use different moments or event geometry.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: published quantile evidence reports a role for lagged Bitcoin realized kurtosis in upper return tails; the candidate separately requires causal elevated BTC variation
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: a daily fourth-moment price-discovery clock is absent from Gross9

features.returns: 288 close-to-close log returns; first return uses D 00:00 close versus D-1 23:55 close
features.day_return: log(D 23:55 close / D 00:00 open), strict nonzero
features.kurtosis_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid completed days, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.80
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank of sqrt(realized_variation) over same policy, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: daily nonoverlapping; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

definitions.no_kurtosis_tail: day direction and variation gate without kurtosis rank
definitions.no_variation_gate: day direction and kurtosis tail only

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.paper: Quantile prediction for Bitcoin returns using financial assets' realized measures, Finance Research Letters 55A (2023) 103843

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no source, moment, rank, variation, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
